name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_forma_positiva
statement:
theorem gram_forma_positiva {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (α : ι → E n)
    (hind : LinearIndependent ℝ α) (g : ι → ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, g i * g j * ⟪α i, α j⟫
proof:
:= by
  
  have hform : (∑ i, ∑ j, g i * g j * ⟪α i, α j⟫)
      = ⟪∑ i, g i • α i, ∑ j, g j • α j⟫ := by
    rw [sum_inner]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro i _
    rw [inner_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro j _
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  rw [hform, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hne : (∑ i, g i • α i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hg
    funext i
    exact (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hind) g h i
  positivity

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.proporzionali_su_retta_seme
statement:
theorem proporzionali_su_retta_seme {v : Fin n → E n} {z₁ z₂ : E n}
    {i₀ : Fin n}
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = ⊤)
    (h₁ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → ⟪v i, z₁⟫ = 0)
    (h₂ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → ⟪v i, z₂⟫ = 0)
    (hz₂ : z₂ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, z₁ = s • z₂
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : ⟪v i₀, z₂⟫ • z₁ - ⟪v i₀, z₁⟫ • z₂ = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_inner_span_top hspan
    intro i
    rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      ring
    · rw [h₁ i hi, h₂ i hi]
      ring
  have hden : ⟪v i₀, z₂⟫ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hz₂
    apply eq_zero_of_inner_span_top hspan
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      exact h0
    · exact h₂ i hi
  refine ⟨⟪v i₀, z₁⟫ / ⟪v i₀, z₂⟫, ?_⟩
  have heq : ⟪v i₀, z₂⟫ • z₁ = ⟪v i₀, z₁⟫ • z₂ := sub_eq_zero.mp hkey
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul, ← smul_smul, ← heq, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ hden, one_smul]

namespace LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification

open ConvexPolytope

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- Un vettore ortogonale a una famiglia che genera tutto è nullo. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_inner_span_top {v : Fin n → E n} {z : E n}
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = ⊤)
    (hz : ∀ i, ⟪v i, z⟫ = 0) : z = 0 := by
  have h1 : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)
      ≤ (Submodule.span ℝ {z})ᗮ := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro u ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm, hz i, mul_zero]
  rw [hspan] at h1
  have h3 : z ∈ (Submodule.span ℝ {z})ᗮ := h1 Submodule.mem_top
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal] at h3
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp
    (h3 z (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self z))

/-- **Due vettori sulla retta del seme sono proporzionali**: ortogonali a
tutti i generatori tranne `i₀`, col secondo non nullo. -/
